etymology.historical_story: If the token denotes the surname Baxter, its history belongs to English and Scots, not Malay word formation. Historical dictionaries connect baxter with baking, and surname references identify an occupational origin. That history does not establish what this lowercase token means in its original text, nor does it make baker a Malay definition. [Scots dictionary](https://dsl.ac.uk/entry/dost00052620), [surname reference](https://www.ancestry.co.uk/last-name-meaning/baxter)
